description: This computer's update panel, drawn by the shell as a popup while the main window shows another computer. Bundled page only; Rust additionally verifies the exact page and allows only state, this computer's updater and the selected instance's update actions. It reports its panel's height so the shell sizes this window; Rust admits that only from this popup's page. The popup closes its own window (Escape or its backdrop); window close takes a label, which only this bundled page's code supplies.
